prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a production layered pixel sprite sheet from this exact tactical-map armored guardian. SAME identity, hairstyle, proportions, white plate armor, blue tunic and navy outlines. Shield must face OUTWARDS TOWARD VIEWER: show its full blue rectangular front, white rim and white diamond emblem on image-right, as in the reference, NEVER a thin side edge or horizontal board. Matte materials, solid gray-brown hair, no hair shine, no glossy cloth.
Output FOUR isolated assets in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, generous transparent gutters, no text. First column: ONE STATIC BODY, complete head, torso, pelvis, both planted legs and full FRONT-FACING SHIELD held by the image-right arm. Keep the image-left shoulder pauldron attached to body, but OMIT the free spear-holding arm below that pauldron: no upper arm below its socket, elbow, forearm, glove or spear in this first asset. Leave an exposed small dark socket under the image-left pauldron for the arm animation. This one body will be reused unchanged in every frame so it cannot bob. Keep its chest fully drawn behind the omitted arm. No spear, no short stick, no vertical shaft anywhere in first asset.
Columns2,3,4: THREE SEPARATE COMPLETE ARM SPRITES ONLY, belonging to the omitted image-left arm, designed to attach under that shoulder. Each arm must include white/navy armored upper arm, a bent elbow and closed armored fist. Each top/right shoulder socket and upper arm has IDENTICAL orientation and scale. Upper arm descends from top-right socket to elbow, forearm folds towards image-left, where the hand grips an imaginary VERTICAL spear. The fist horizontal distance from shoulder socket is identical across all three. Only forearm/hand height changes slightly: column2 fist LOW below elbow, column3 fist MIDDLE level with elbow, column4 fist HIGH above elbow. The elbow and shoulder socket do not move. Do NOT rotate, scale or shift the entire body between frames because there is only one static body. Keep the detached arms at the same scale as the body, do not enlarge them to fill their columns. Each glove is clearly curled to grip a vertical shaft. NO spear or stub in the arm sprites. Spear will be supplied as a separate existing fixed-length asset. These are intentionally separate game rig layers. Body has exactly one visible front-facing full shield, no other shields. Exactly one base body plus three arm assets. Transparent background, no floor, glow, shadow, labels or extra objects.
